start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, aapne 160 kaha—us question par end mein lautenge. Ab vegetable patch ko fence karne ke liye boundary ke saare sides jodiye: aap kya choose karenge?
Kabir, lag raha hai sawaal bahut heavy ho gaya; pehle safe rahenge: kya aapko sach mein khud ko chot pahunchane ka khayal aa raha hai?
